items.source: Set to true will persist Constants.NAME_OF_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE to Class.getSimpleName() as a property in relationships.
items.translation: 设置为 true 将持久化 Constants.NAME_OF_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE 为关系中的属性转换为 Class.getSimpleName()。

items.source: Set to true will persist Constants.NAME_OF_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE to Class.getSimpleName() as a property in relationships. This property will be used to determine the type of the relationship when mapping back to the domain model.
items.translation: 设置为 true 将持久化 Constants.NAME_OF_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE 为 Class.getSimpleName() 作为关系中的属性。该属性将用于在映射回领域模型时确定关系的类型。
杰里特·迈尔，迈克尔·J·西蒙斯

items.source: whether to persist type information for the annotated class.
items.translation: 是否保留已标注类的类型信息。
